question: The award was given to a ______ scientist who had made an important contribution.
solution:
Notable: Important and deserving attention (ध्यान देने लायक)
Notorious: Known for bad qualities (कुख्यात)
Famous: Well known (प्रसिद्ध)
Eminent: Well known and respected (प्रसिद्ध एवं सम्माननीय)

question: The new notice is ______ and must be followed by all employees.
solution:
Official: Relating to an office (आधिकारिक)
Officious: Too eager to tell others what to do (सलाह देने के लिए तत्पर)

question: The government issued an ______ to regulate the emergency situation.
solution:
Ordinance: A law made by the government (अध्यादेश)
Ordnance: Military material such as weapons, ammunition etc. (सेना का साजो-सामान)

question: The broken ______ of the window was replaced yesterday.
solution:
Pane: A flat piece of glass used in a window/door (खिड़की/दरवाजे का काँच)
Pain: Feeling of physical suffering (दर्द)
Pains: A lot of efforts (अथक प्रयास)

question: The chef carefully checked the ______ of the dish before serving it.
solution:
Palate: The roof of the mouth / the sense of taste (तालू)
Palette: An artist's mixing board (रंग मिलाने का बर्तन)
Pellet: A small ball of any substance (किसी चीज़ का छोटा गोला)

question: Pressing the ______ makes the bicycle move forward.
solution:
Pedal: A foot-operated lever (पैर से चलाने वाला)
Peddle: To sell goods by going from one place to another (घूम-घूम कर सामान बेचना)

question: The offender was accused of trying to ______ a serious crime.
solution:
Perpetrate: To commit (a crime) (करना/गुनाह)
Perpetuate: To cause something to continue (किसी कार्य/हालात के जारी रहने का कारण बनना)

question: Please keep my ______ information confidential.
solution:
Personal: Private (निजी)
Personnel: Staff (कर्मी)

question: Water began to ______ from the broken pipe.
solution:
Pore: Small hole (छेद)
Pour: Flow, cause to flow (बहना, उड़ेलना)

question: Daily ______ is necessary to improve your English.
solution:
Practice (N): Regular activity (अभ्यास)
Practise (V): To do something regularly (अभ्यास करना)

question: We need a ______ solution that can actually be implemented.
solution:
Practicable: Able to be done (व्यवहारिक)
Practical/Pragmatic: Effective or realistic (वास्तव में/प्रयोगात्मक; प्रभावी या यथार्थवादी)

question: The doctor will ______ some medicine for the patient.
solution:
Prescribe: To recommend (सलाह देना (के रूप में))
Proscribe: Forbid or condemn (गैर कानूनी करार देना)

question: We should ______ with the meeting despite the delay.
solution:
Proceed: To continue (आगे बढ़ना)
Precede: To come before/happen before (पहले आना)

question: This restaurant is very ______ among young people.
solution:
Popular: Liked by all (प्रसिद्ध)
Populous: Thickly populated (घनी आबादी वाला)

question: The devotees gathered in the temple to ______ to God.
solution:
Pray: To offer prayer to God (प्रार्थना करना)
Prey: Hunt and kill / victim (शिकार करना/शिकार)

question: The school ______ addressed the students during the assembly.
solution:
Principal: One who is in charge of a school / first in order of importance (प्रधानाचार्य/मुख्य)
Principle: Most important basic idea / moral rule (सिद्धान्त)

question: I am ______ sure that the plan will succeed.
solution:
Quite: Completely / a little (पूर्ण/थोड़ा)
Quiet: To be silent (चुप)
Quit: To give up (छोड़ देना)

question: The guest was very ______ while speaking to the elderly people.
solution:
Respectable: Worthy of respect (सम्माननीय)
Respectful: Showing respect (सम्मानजनक)
Respective: Particular (विशिष्ट, अलग-अलग)

question: Clean drinking water is an important natural ______.
solution:
Resource: Means (संसाधन)
Recourse: Resort (रास्ता)

question: The evidence was strong enough to ______ his claim as false.
solution:
Refute: Prove to be wrong (खंडन करना)
Repudiate: Refuse to accept as true or correct (सही या सच मानने से इंकार करना)

question: The accident was highly ______ and could have been avoided.
solution:
Regrettable: Causing regret, undesirable (खेदजनक)
Regretful: Feeling sorry (दुखी)

question: The price of the shares began to ______ rapidly.
solution:
Rise: To get up, to progress (उठना/जागना/तरक्की करना)
Raise: To lift (उठाना)
Raze: To demolish (ध्वस्त करना)
Rage: Anger (गुस्सा)

question: We decided to ______ a horse during the village fair.
solution:
Ride: To sit on an animal or two-wheeler and travel (घोड़े या जानवर की सवारी करना)
Drive: To travel by a four-wheeler (चार-पहिया की सवारी करना)

question: The soldiers found a safe ______ through the mountains.
solution:
Route: Path (रास्ता)
Rout: To defeat completely and easily (धड़ाशायी करना)
Root: The underground part of a plant (जड़)

question: The patient developed a ______ infection after the wound became badly infected.
solution:
Septic: A medical term involving sepsis (एक चिकित्सा संबंधी समस्या)
Sceptic: Doubtful of an idea or belief (संदेही)

question: I can ______ the mountains clearly from this window.
solution:
See: Perceive with eyes (देखना)
Look: To direct the eyes in order to see (ताकना/नजर डालना)
Watch: To look at something for a period of time / to keep an eye on (देखना (कुछ अंतराल तक)/नजर रखना)
Stare: To look continuously for a long time (घूरना)
Peep: To see secretly or through a hole (झाँकना)
Glance: To give a quick short look (नजर डालना)
Glare: To stare angrily (गुस्से में घूरना)
Glimpse: To see someone very briefly (एक झलक देखना)
Glower: To see angrily (गुस्से से देखना)

question: The surgeon had to ______ the damaged part of the body.
solution:
Sever: To break / to separate (अलग करना)
Amputate: Cut off a body part that is permanently damaged (शरीर के किसी बाहरी अंग को काट कर अलग करना, क्योंकि वह स्थायी रूप से क्षतिग्रस्त हो चुका है)
Maim: To damage any body part permanently (शरीर के किसी अंग को स्थायी रूप से क्षतिग्रस्त करना)
Severe: Extreme (तीव्र)
Sewer: Drain (नाला)

question: The book gives a detailed ______ of the historical event.
solution:
Story: Account of any event (कहानी)
Storey: Floor (तल)

question: The lawyer decided to ______ the company for breach of contract.
solution:
Suit: Action in a law court (वाद/अभियोग)
Soot: Black substance in smoke (कालिख)
Suite: A set of rooms / furniture (सेट)

question: The sculptor created a beautiful ______ of the leader.
solution:
Statue: Image (मूर्ति)
Statute: Written law (लिखित कानून)

question: Draw a ______ line from one point to the other.
solution:
Straight: Extending without a curve (सीधा)
Strait: Narrow passage of water (जलसंधि)

question: The car remained ______ in the parking area.
solution:
Stationary: Not moving (स्थिर)
Stationery: Things needed for writing (पेन, कॉपी इत्यादि)

question: The construction workers inspected the ______ before starting work.
solution:
Sight: Ability to see/view (दृष्टि/नजारा)
Site: A place of construction (कार्यस्थल)
Cite: To mention (उल्लेख करना)

question: The barber will ______ the customer's hair this afternoon.
solution:
Shear: To cut off-hair, wool etc. (काटना (बाल, ऊन, इत्यादि))
Sheer: Utter, complete (पूर्ण रूप से)

question: He injured his little ______ while playing football.
solution:
Toe: Any of the five separate parts at the end of the foot (पैर के अंगुली)
Tow: To pull a vehicle using a rope or chain tied to another vehicle (खींच कर गाड़ी ले जाना)

question: The coach tried to ______ the angry player.
solution:
Temper: Anger, rage (गुस्सा)
Tamper: To interfere with (छेड़-छाड़ करना (किसी चीज से))

question: This is only a ______ arrangement until a permanent solution is found.
solution:
Temporary: Short lived (क्षणिक, तत्कालिक)
Temporal: Earthly or worldly (सांसारिक)

question: The advertisement was designed to ______ the audience.
solution:
Titillate: Stimulate or excite especially in a sexual way (उत्तेजित करना)
Titivation: To make smarter or more pretty (सुन्दरता बढ़ाना)

question: The article discusses a ______ issue that is being debated today.
solution:
Topical: Related to present time (प्रासंगिक/आधुनिक विषय से)
Tropical: With hot climate (उष्ण)

question: The proposal failed because it was ______.
solution:
Vain: Not successful/arrogant (बेकार में/घमंडी)
Vein: Tube that carries blood to the heart in our body (नाड़ी)

question: His answer was too ______ and difficult to follow.
solution:
Verbal: Relating to words (शाब्दिक)
Verbose: Containing more words than necessary (शब्दों से भरा)
Oral: Spoken (मौखिक)
Verbiage: Use of too many words due to which it becomes difficult for one to understand the speech or article (जरूरत से ज्यादा शब्दों भरा जिससे अर्थ समझना कठिन हो जाए)

question: The leader was admired for his ______ character.
solution:
Virtuous: Having good moral qualities (नैतिक रूप से अच्छा)
Virtual: In effect, though not in fact (आभासीय)

question: The corrupt official was known to use ______ to get his work done.
solution:
Vile: Immoral (नीच)
Wile: Tricks (युक्ति)

question: The narrow ______ between the hills is beautiful.
solution:
Vale: Valley (घाटी)
Veil: Cover of face (नकाब, घूँघट)
Wail: Weep (रोना)

question: Teaching is her chosen ______.
solution:
Vocation: Profession (व्यवसाय)
Vacation: Holidays (अवकाश)

question: The protesters were arrested for acts of ______.
solution:
Violence: Force (हिंसा, प्रहार)
Violation: Infringement of law (नियम की अवहेलना)

question: The leaves began to ______ in the extreme heat.
solution:
Wither: To fade (मुरझा जाना)
Whither: Where (कहाँ)
Weather: Atmospheric condition of a short period (मौसम)
Whether: 'Whether .... or' is a co-relative (या......या)

question: The fisherman watched a huge ______ rise near the boat.
solution:
Wave: Raised mass of water in sea / to move (लहर (N)/ लहराना (V))
Waive: To give up (त्याग देना)
